questionText:

Surya Engineering Tools Ltd. implemented F.W. Taylor's Differential Piece Wage System to motivate shopfloor machinists. The management instituted two distinct wage rates: a higher piece rate of Rs. 50 per unit for workers who produce standard output or more, and a lower piece rate of Rs. 40 per unit for workers who produce less than standard output. options.text: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
